actions.create_event.description: Create a custom event (goal) for a specific site.
actions.create_event.props.site_id.descr: The unique identifier for the Fathom site.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_aggregation.description: Generate a custom analytics aggregation report. Supports flexible grouping, filtering, and date ranges.
actions.get_aggregation.props.aggregates: The metrics to include in the report.
Start date for the report in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z).
actions.get_aggregation.props.date_group: Group results by this time unit.
actions.get_aggregation.props.date_to.de: End date for the report in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-12-31T23:59:59.999999Z).
actions.get_aggregation.props.entity.des: Whether to aggregate pageviews or events.
The Fathom site ID to query (e.g., CDBUGS). Required when Entity Type is "Pageview".
actions.get_aggregation.props.entity_nam: The ID of the specific event to aggregate. Required when Entity Type is "Event". Find event IDs via the List Events action.
actions.get_aggregation.props.field_grou: Group results by this field (e.g., pathname, browser). Makes the report actionable by breaking down totals.
actions.get_aggregation.props.filters.de: Optional array of filter objects. Example: [{"property": "pathname", "operator": "is", "value": "/blog"}]
actions.get_aggregation.props.limit.desc: Maximum number of results to return.
actions.get_aggregation.props.site_id.de: The Fathom site ID that owns the event. Required when Entity Type is "Event".
actions.get_aggregation.props.sort_by.de: Field and direction to sort by (e.g., "pageviews:desc" or "uniques:asc").
actions.get_aggregation.props.timezone.d: Timezone for the report (e.g., "America/New_York", "Europe/London"). Defaults to UTC.
actions.get_site.description: Retrieve details for a specific site by its ID.
actions.get_site.props.site_id.descripti: The unique identifier for the Fathom site (e.g., CDBUGS).
actions.list_events.description: List all custom events (goals) for a specific site.
Cursor for backward pagination — the first event ID from the previous page.
actions.list_events.props.limit.descript: Number of events to return (1–100). Default is 10.
actions.list_events.props.site_id.descri: The unique identifier for the Fathom site.
actions.list_events.props.starting_after: Cursor for forward pagination — the last event ID from the previous page.
actions.list_sites.description: Return a list of all sites this API key has access to.
actions.list_sites.props.ending_before.d: Cursor for backward pagination — the first site ID from the previous page.
actions.list_sites.props.limit.descripti: Number of sites to return (1–100). Default is 10.
Cursor for forward pagination — the last site ID from the previous page.
auth.description:
To create an API token:
1. Go to [https://app.usefathom.com/api](https://app.usefathom.com/api)
2. Click **Create new**
3. Give your token a name and set permissions (Admin, Read Only, or site-specific)
4. Click **Save changes**
5. Copy your API token — you won't be able to retrieve it again after navigating away
description: Privacy-focused website analytics. Query your site traffic, manage sites and events, and generate custom reports.
